_comment: Co-op ROM hacks: hacks that put 2-4 players into one console. When the owner picks a library ROM that matches a 'base', Retro Hub offers 'Patch for co-op' next to it: it applies the patch to a copy in cache/coop/ (the original ROM is never changed), switches on the hack's required Project64 cheats, routes each online seat to the controller port the hack uses, and plays it in Project64. Retro Hub doesn't host or download patches: it finds the patch file by its SHA-256 next to the ROM, in the console's folders (3 levels: e.g. N64/Patches/...), or in the hub's patches/ folder, or the owner adds it in the host form. base.n64: header checksums + country as Project64 names them. ports: online seat (1 = P2 ... 3 = P4) -> controller port the hack reads (0-3), null = that seat isn't used. near: ROMs that are close but not the base, each with a note shown instead of the button (a list, or one object). not_md5: never accept these as the base.

hacks.name: OoT Multiplayer
hacks.credit: spinout182 (hack), jmanx990 and Sho' (cheat list, v1.0.3)

base.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Debug ROM (header 917D18F6-69BC5453, "Master Quest (U) (Debug)" in Project64)

near.note: This is the PAL Debug ROM (871E1C92-509D8A96). OoT Multiplayer v1.0.3 doesn't work on it: tested, Project64 stops with a fatal error. It needs the Debug ROM dump with header 917D18F6-69BC5453 (Project64 lists it as "Master Quest (U) (Debug)").
This ROM is already an OoT Multiplayer build: host it as it is under Nintendo 64 (Project64) and switch on its cheat list in Project64 ("4 Swords Codes" for 4P, "OoT 2 Player Codes" for 2P).
OoT Multiplayer is made for the Ocarina of Time Debug ROM, not a retail cartridge. For co-op with a retail copy, see Z64Online (ModLoader64) or the Ship of Harkinian / Squadala PC ports.

variants.name: OoT Multiplayer 2P
variants.notes: Player 2 is controller 4 in this version: Retro Hub sends the P2 seat there. Keep 4 controllers mapped in Project64 (Options > Configure Controller Plugin).

hacks.tested: Not yet on its own base ROM: the patch and cheat list are checked by SHA-256; on the PAL Debug ROM the patched game crashes, so that ROM is refused.
